profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Smartsheet | ex Microsoft
profile.summary: Experienced Level 2 Frontend Engineer with 5 years of experience in designing, developing, and optimizing web applications using modern front-end JavaScript frameworks such as React, Redux, TypeScript, and NodeJS with a focus on delivering high-quality projects through collaboration and innovation.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Resource Management by Smartsheet ( https://www.smartsheet.com/platform/resource-management )
- Unified and streamlined the authentication and authorization processes between Smartsheet and Resource Management, a product acquired by Smartsheet.
- Improved the CI/CD pipeline by integrating Smartsheet's Artifactory with the Resource Management Panel. This involved migrating the codebase from GitHub to a monorepo within Smartsheet's GitLab instance, secured via a corporate VPN, while preserving all commit history using Git Subtree.
- Migrated End-to-End (E2E) tests from Selenium WebDriver to Playwright, significantly reducing testing time by further parallelizing test pipelines across different scopes and platforms.
- Modernized the Resource Management UI within Smartsheet by migrating to a micro-frontend architecture, enhancing integration with release and deployment pipelines.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Project Science Engine ( https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/project/project-s )
- Optimized product performance with large datasets by refining scroll virtualization logic using the react-window library.
- Brought feature parity with Excel, introducing advanced table controls like Freeze Panes and Drag to Select Multiple Cells on the existing scroll virtualization framework.
- Developed a feature enabling users to explore nested information within datasets, enhancing data exploration capabilities.
- Reduced user cognitive load by introducing a feature allowing data preview without switching context.
- Enhanced browsing and searching experiences by integrating AI-augmented metadata into the UI.
- Improved user discoverability through meaningful AI-recommended actions.
- Reduced first paint time and enhanced data state communication with skeleton loading screens.
- Pioneered a flexible theming system with interchangeable design tokens, minimizing fragmentation and ensuring consistency across the product.
- Improved product transparency by refining the notification flow in collaboration with the backend team.
- Optimized CSS bundling and delivery logic to reduce load time, enhance cross-platform compatibility, and fortify against reverse engineering.
- Achieved and maintained source code maturity with a code coverage of 90% or above in all unit tests.
- Ensured source code stability through strict TypeScript compiler options, contributing to a robust development environment.
- Expedited development by creating scripts for emulating the production server on local machines, facilitating efficient testing for developers.
- Led collaboration among backend, frontend, and data science teams, establishing a contract for a critical P0 feature, providing AI insights to users.
- Initiated and led a virtual team to proactively address upcoming design changes across Microsoft, ensuring product readiness before public announcements.
